mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_participant ( conversation_id, participant_id, participant_type, role, join_time, last_read_time, unread_count, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{participantId}, #{participantType}, #{role}, NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id AS conversationId, participant_id AS participantId, participant_type AS participantType, role, join_time AS joinTime, last_read_time AS lastReadTime, unread_count AS unreadCount, is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM conversation_participant WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND is_deleted = 0
